contentTopics: Transit line connections and operating days
goal.questionDirective: Give one two-step journey question and one operating-day comparison question using the handbook. Include the passenger’s starting point or requested day as needed, but do not repeat the tested handbook facts in the stem.

skills.name: Selden routes
skills.detail: The fictional Selden system has exactly three bidirectional lines and four stations. Copper joins Harbor and Market. Silver joins Market and Ridge. Gold joins Ridge and Park. These are the only links; changing lines is allowed at shared stations.

objectives.name: Apply route and service facts
objectives.detail: Copper runs only Monday, Wednesday and Friday. Silver runs only Monday and Friday. Gold runs only Wednesday and Friday. A journey is possible only when every line used runs that day. Every named line runs all day on its operating days.

correct answer. Write a short explanation showing why that answer follows.

raw_questions.prompt: Starting at Harbor, what is the earliest possible arrival time at Park on a Wednesday?
raw_questions.explanation: To travel from Harbor to Park on a Wednesday, one must take the Copper line from Harbor to Market and then switch to the Gold line from Market to Park. Copper runs all day on Wednesday, so the earliest arrival at Market is 08:00 AM. Gold also runs all day on Wednesday, so the earliest arrival at Park is 10:00 AM.

raw_questions.prompt: On which days can a passenger travel directly from Ridge to Harbor without changing lines?
raw_questions.explanation: To travel directly from Ridge to Harbor, a passenger must use the Silver line, which connects Market and Ridge, and the Copper line, which connects Harbor and Market. Silver runs on Monday and Friday, and Copper runs on Monday, Wednesday, and Friday. Therefore, the only days both lines run are Monday and Friday.
